name: lan-file-share
title: LAN File Share
description: Open a sharing session on your local network: hand out one link so anyone nearby can download and send files or drop you text, with nothing to install on their side.
author: shaomai98

commands.name: share
commands.title: LAN File Share
commands.description: Start, stop and monitor the sharing session, choose the network interface, and show the link or QR code.

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Port
preferences.description: Port the sharing service listens on. Must be an integer between 1024 and 49151. Changing it needs a restart.

preferences.name: receiveDirectory
preferences.title: Receive Directory
preferences.description: Directory that files uploaded from the browser are saved into. They are added to the share list afterwards.
